entities.summary: John Patrick Foley was an American Catholic prelate who served as Grand Master of the Equestrian Order of the Holy Sepulchre of Jerusalem from 2007 to 2011. He previously served as -president of the Pontifical Council for Social Communications from 1984 to 2007. He was elevated to the cardinalate in 2007.
